notes.title: Patch v1.2 - News
notes.notes:
What's new in this update:

 Player collision box redone (now 1 block)
 Tree collision not working: fixed
 Candy Island redesigned
 Leveling system reworked
 Slimes now spawn in every island

notes.title: Patch v1.2 - Linux support now working!
notes.notes:
After a few tweaks,
the linux version of the game is finally working!

notes.title: Patch v1.1 - News
notes.notes:
Patch v1.1 changes:

 Leveling system reworked (more difficult to level up)
 Ennemies spawn system reworked (ennemies spawn a lot more and at normal places)
 Fixed a bug: Can click through the load and reset button when we're not on the Slots selection menu

notes.title: Big bug fixes!
notes.notes:
While we're still working on the V1.0.
We can already offer a big update!

What's new:

 Save system is finally working again!
 HUD already redisgned!
 Game is now on Linux, Windows and Mac!

notes.title: First official release is coming!
notes.notes:
I saw a lot of interest in Squaxel.
I never imagined it was possible for someone like me to get much exposure on my little game, but here it is...

Without further ado.

Squaxel V1.0 is coming!

What does it mean?
That Squaxel will no longer be in early access.

And because I don't want to leave you without informations about the next release, this is what is coming:

 New starting menu.
 New color scheme (already done in the Steam page of the game).
 The Arena Island (a place to farm XP)!
 Reworked some animations.
 The Candy Island.
 Max level is now 25.
 And a lot more that I will not spoil...


So stay tuned for the first big update of the game!
